rules: Use original rank_cases unchanged; retain all recall and order.
Resolve declared local file, raw SHA256, one-based line, record ID, and exact excerpt/body against independently written source file.
Missing file, SHA mismatch, line missing, ID mismatch or excerpt/body mismatch must fail traceability.
LOCATED never sets relevance/support/causation true. Semantic review remains pending for every card.
Card1 is a deliberate wrong-file reference to text from source-records.txt; not a separately invented quotation.
Card2 text expressly concerns unconfirmed other-vessel allegation; card3 records observation only. These are human-readable boundaries, not machine semantic labels.
No labels from old corpus or answers used in rank or resolver.
